    '| 17  |': '128->136 0.15509/129->136 0.19246/132->137 -0.27063/133->140 -0.15124/134->139 0.51033/135->139 0.11053/135->141 0.21227',
    '| 18  |': '130->136 -0.10405/131->137 0.56214/132->138 -0.10312/133->138 0.21098/134->140 -0.13350',
    '| 19  |': '129->136 0.46801/132->137 0.32734/133->140 -0.15455/134->139 -0.12809/135->141 0.28987',
    '| 20  |': '130->136 0.15502/133->139 -0.10020/134->140 0.63810/135->142 -0.12690',
}
for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
    ln2 = ln.rstrip('\r')
    for prefix, comp in comps.items():
        if ln2.startswith(prefix):
            after_idx = ln2.find('| 0')  # position of '|' before 振子强度 value... actually find the '|' after 振子强度
            # locate the 6th '|' (the one before 跃迁分量 cell)
            pipe_positions = [p for p in range(len(ln2)) if ln2[p] == '|']
            if len(pipe_positions) >= 6:
                sep6 = pipe_positions[5]
                tail = ln2[sep6:]
                assert set(tail[1:]) <= {' '}, 'unexpected chars in cell for ' + prefix + ': ' + repr(tail)
                width = len(tail) - 1  # spaces inside cell
                new_cell = ' ' + comp
                assert len(new_cell) == width, (prefix, len(new_cell), width)
                lines[i] = ln2[:sep6] + new_cell + ' |' + ('\r' if ln.endswith('\r') else '')
                print('comp edit applied:', prefix.strip(), 'index', i, 'cellwidth', width, 'complen', len(comp))
            break

with io.open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(lines))
print('done, newline style:', repr(newline))
